method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (Gaussian 16, EmpiricalDispersion=GD3BJ), gas phase, isolated neutral singlet amine oxide; energies are electronic only (no ZPE or thermal correction)
atom_map_convention: All SMILES strings carry explicit atom-map numbers in the order of the user-supplied reactant SMILES CC([N+](C)(C)[O-])C(C)c1ccccc1: map 1 = CH3 on C2, map 2 = C2 (N-bearing), map 3 = N, maps 4/5 = N-methyls, map 6 = O of the N-oxide, map 7 = C3 (phenyl-bearing), map 8 = CH3 on C3, maps 9-14 = phenyl (9 = ipso), map 15 = H on C3, map 16 = the H of the C2-methyl that is transferred in the regio channel, maps 17-19 = H of the C3-methyl, map 20 = H on C2, maps 21-22 = the other two H of the C2-methyl, maps 23-27 = phenyl H, maps 28-33 = N-methyl H. The user SMILES numbers no hydrogens, so maps 15-33 are a documented extension of its heavy-atom numbering; every bond_changes pair below uses this numbering.

What is still missing for this channel is only the connectivity proof: the bidirectional IRC (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0010/irc/irc.log) was still running at the time of writing, and no Opt Freq logs started from its two outer frames exist yet, and the substrate-side CIP has not been re-derived at an IRC reactant endpoint. The barrier therefore stays provisional; the (Z) assignment itself is geometry-derived.

notes: Barriers are electronic Delta-E(double dagger) values in kcal/mol with no ZPE or thermal correction, each referred to the lowest verified minimum of its OWN substrate (threo min_T/conf2.log -598.235079154 Ha; erythro min_E/conf1.log -598.233321710 Ha). Energies are never subtracted across the two diastereomers; each diastereomer is its own reactant node. Four channels are recorded: the syn elimination of the C3 hydrogen (main channel, N-O retained, giving 2-phenyl-2-butene) and the regioisomeric elimination of a C2-methyl hydrogen (giving 3-phenylbut-1-ene), for each of the two substrates. Alkene E/Z and the C3 descriptor of 3-phenylbut-1-ene are read from the computed product geometries (RDKit AssignStereochemistryFrom3D), not assumed from the substrate configuration. Bond changes use the documented user-map numbering.
